sources.title: OneReason Technical Report
sources.snippet: For the Reasoning property, we acknowledge that the recommendation-data-driven OneRec model cannot unlock the reasoning ability on its own. Since the OneRec model is trained exclusively on pure itemic sequential data, it has only learned from flat transition patterns without any underlying logical thinking traces.
